title: Time and Fragility
coreMove: Use survival across time as evidence, while still asking what exposures the thing has actually faced.
sourcePressure: This chapter begins Via Negativa by treating time as a revealer of hidden fragility and survival information.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Turning time into generic patience or nostalgia.

sourceAnchors.name: time
sourceAnchors.detail: the source-note filter that reveals hidden fragility through exposure
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Time is not sentimental; it is the slow test that keeps asking what broke.

sourceAnchors.name: survival information
sourceAnchors.detail: the chapter treats endurance as evidence, not decoration
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The thing that lasted has at least faced more seasons than the thing that only looks new.

hook: opening by explaining Time and Fragility
counterintuition: Turning time into generic patience or nostalgia.
tryThisNow: make a pros and cons list with no exposure map

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person You direct address, retrospective It took her three weeks to see, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps
